Professional Experience  
**HealthInsight Analytics** | Machine Learning Engineer (2023–present)  
Led development of predictive analytics models for chronic disease management, integrating longitudinal patient data with real-time IoT sensor inputs. Spearheaded containerization of ML workflows using Docker and Kubernetes, achieving 99.95% uptime for production services. Designed NLP pipelines to extract structured insights from unstructured clinical notes, improving diagnostic accuracy by 18% in pilot studies.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design REST APIs for seamless integration of ML outputs into hospital EHR systems. Pioneered use of PyTorch for developing custom architectures in radiology analysis, reducing manual review time by 22% for radiologists.
